snippet.title: Star Trucker | Coming to PlayStation 5 on June 10th
snippet.description:
The wait is over! Star Trucker is coming to PlayStation 5 on June 10th, 2025. 
Search for fame and fortune among the stars in a game that puts an interstellar twist on the truck sim genre: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10008262/
